headline: Alabama passed a new IVF law. But questions remain.
snippet: Legal experts questioned whether immunity law fully resolved embryo personhood status.

headline: Alabama governor signs legislation protecting IVF providers from legal liability into law
snippet: Ivey swiftly signed HB237, clinics resumed services after signing.

headline: Alabama Legislature passes bills aimed at protecting in vitro fertilization
snippet: Rapidly passed after AL Supreme Court ruled frozen embryos are legally persons, causing clinics to halt.

headline: Alabama Legislature advances law protecting in vitro fertilization
snippet: Swift advancement as UAB and other clinics halted services following court ruling.
